verdicts.fix: Add hand.json entries (auto.json is generated): انْتَهَتْ '(she, it f) ended, is over; (they) ended, with a plural of things'; تُعْطِيكَ '(she, it f) gives you (to a man); (they) give you, with a plural of things'; تُخْلَعُ '(it, f) is taken off; (they) are taken off, with a plural of things'; تَدْخُلَ '(she, it f) enters; you enter (to a man) (form after an)'; تُرْجِمَتْ '(it, f) was translated; (they) were translated, with a plural of things'; تَصِلَ '(she, it f) arrives; you arrive (to a man) (form after an)'; تُطْفَأُ '(it, f) is switched off; (they) are switched off, with a plural of things'; أُعْلِنَتِ '(it, f) was announced; (they) were announced, with a plural of things (-i links to the next word)'
verdicts.scope: app-wide via content/glossary/hand.json, then regenerate auto.json (npm run glossary:auto)
verdicts.reason: Real: these are 3fs (and ta- 2ms) forms glossed only 'they'. But a hand.json entry overrides lesson glosses in every tap line (meaningOf checks hand before the lesson day), and the forms occur in lesson tap lines whose subject is a non-human plural (e.g. أُعْلِنَتِ النَّتَائِج, «يَعْنِي» وَ«كَيْفَ أَقُولُ» تُعْطِيكَ). Dropping 'they' would make those taps wrong, so the app-wide gloss must give the singular meaning and the plural-of-things use. Editing auto.json directly has no effect (it is a generated review list, not read by the app).

verdicts.fix: حَرْب: war; Harb (in the street name Talaat Harb)
verdicts.reason: حَرْب is the common noun 'war' (الْحَرْب 'the war' in the course); round 3's two-readings policy applies. Both readings are true everywhere.

verdicts.fix: دَوْرَةُ: course, cycle, round (of) (dawratu l-miyāh: toilet)
verdicts.reason: دَوْرَة does not mean 'room'; that sense comes from the set phrase دَوْرَةُ الْمِيَاهِ. The fix keeps the phrase meaning visible for the lesson line.

verdicts.scope: app-wide via hand.json or by correcting the source seg (regenerate auto.json)
verdicts.reason: الْجَبَل is singular (plural الْجِبَال); '(s)' teaches a wrong number.

verdicts.fix: الْمَلْعَبَ: the pitch, the sports ground
verdicts.scope: app-wide via hand.json or the source seg (regenerate auto.json)
verdicts.reason: Real: 'the malʿab' is a transliteration, not a meaning. Use the same gloss as الْمَلْعَب ('the pitch, the sports ground') for consistency rather than introducing 'stadium'.

verdicts.fix: إِنَّهَا 'indeed she / it (f) (starts a statement); that she / it (after qāla)'; إِنَّهُ 'indeed he / it (starts a statement); that he / it (after qāla)'; إِنَّكِ 'indeed you (to a woman); that you (after qāla)'
verdicts.reason: Verified in content: إِنَّهَا opens statements (إِنَّهَا الْعَرَبِيَّةُ, إِنَّهَا جَمِيلَة) and follows qāla / yuqālu (قَالَتْ إِنَّهَا مَرِيضَة, يُقَالُ إِنَّهَا ...); إِنَّهُ likewise. The fix mirrors the existing hand gloss of إِنَّ and is right in every line (multi-sense particle, allowed by round-3 policy).

verdicts.fix: أَرَاهَا 'I see her, I see it (f; also 'them' for things)'; رَأَيْتُهَا 'I saw her, I saw it (f; also 'them' for things)'; أَكْتُبْهَا 'I write it (f; also 'them' for things) (form after lam)'; تَقْرَأْهَا 'you read it (f; also 'them' for things) (form after lam)'
verdicts.reason: -hā is 3fs; 'them (things)' alone is a one-sentence sense and is wrong for أَنْ أَرَاهَا أَوَّلًا. The fix keeps the plural-of-things use, so lesson tap lines stay right.

verdicts.fix: تَكْتُبِينَ 'you write (to a woman)'; تَعْنِي 'it (f), she means; you mean (to a man)'
verdicts.reason: A bare 'write' / 'mean' loses person and gender; the course uses تَعْنِي with feminine subjects (الْجُمْلَة كُلُّهَا تَعْنِي, كَلِمَات ... تَعْنِي).

verdicts.fix: تَسْتَمِرُّ: you continue (to a man); she, it (f) continues
verdicts.reason: The key is indicative (-u); the '-a after an' tag belongs to تَسْتَمِرَّ and is wrong here.
fuʿlā with al- is the feminine superlative; the course use is الْمُشْكِلَةَ الْكُبْرَى 'the biggest problem'. 'the bigger' misreads the form.

verdicts.fix: content/days/day62.json: وَادِي رَم → وَادِي رَمّ in dialogue line d62l9 ar and reading.ar, and their segs ['رَم', ...] → ['رَمّ', ...]; the auto key رَم then disappears on regeneration
verdicts.scope: day 62 source lines (2 ar strings + 2 segs)
verdicts.reason: The name is Wādī Ramm (رَمّ, with shadda), as spelt in culture/desert.json, readings.json and the glossary key رَمّ. The unshadda'd form gives a second spelling and the transliteration 'Ram'.

auto.json is a generated review list (scripts/glossary-auto.ts: 'It is a review list, not a lookup table'); the app never reads it at run time (autoGlossary is only used in tests). These keys appear because meaningOf returns the mistakes.json note for a non-word, which is the intended design: the words occur only in mistake cards, and 'I can (wrong — correct: yumkinunī)' is the house style for wrong forms, clearly marked 'wrong'. Deleting them from auto.json would be undone at the next regeneration and changes nothing the learner sees.

summary: Checked all 12 findings against content/glossary/auto.json, hand.json, mistakes.json, the source content, src/lang/ar/tap.ts and scripts/glossary-auto.ts. Key fact for applying fixes: auto.json is GENERATED and not read by the app; corrections must go into content/glossary/hand.json (which overrides every tap line, including lesson lines) or into the source segs, then auto.json is regenerated. 9 AGREE, 2 CHANGE, 1 DISAGREE. CHANGE #1: the 3fs 'they' forms appear in lesson tap lines with non-human plural subjects and a hand entry would override those, so the gloss must give 'she, it (f)' plus 'they, with a plural of things'. CHANGE #5: reuse the existing الْمَلْعَب gloss. DISAGREE #12: removing mistake forms from the generated auto.json has no effect and the mistake-note display is intended.
